description: Golden chart reads, pilot of 10 (constitution §27). For each entry open <symbol> on <tf> in the app and scroll so the LAST CLOSED candle is at <as_of>; the window is the ~120 candles back to <window_start>. Write what YOU see into `expected`: UP / DOWN / RANGE / CHOP. The reader's own call is deliberately not shown here, so your label is not anchored by it. Score with: python -m engine.chartread --golden verification/golden-chart-reads.json

labels.note: Borderline RANGE/CHOP: broad sideways structure with a sharp late-July dip and recovery rather than a clean directional trend.
Borderline: advance is uneven and includes pullbacks, but the window finishes materially above its start with improving short-term structure.
Some late-window giveback after the mid-May push, but the dominant move across the full window is still upward.
Strong late-window acceleration makes this directional despite earlier consolidation.
Borderline CHOP/RANGE: price ends near the starting area after a sharp spike and reversal, with noisy two-way movement dominating.
Borderline and unusually volatile: large swings and failed directional legs dominate the multi-month window, so CHOP fits better than a clean trend label.
Borderline: early weakness is followed by a strong recovery to higher levels; directional bias is up but the path is not clean.
Volatile start, then a clearer sequence of higher prices into the end of the window.
